name: Phlegon
title: Christian in Rome
summary: Phlegon was a Christian who lived in Rome and was greeted by the apostle Paul in his letter to the Romans. He was part of the early Christian community in the capital and represents the many unnamed believers who formed the foundation for the church's growth.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Phlegon was personally mentioned and greeted by the apostle Paul in his letter to the church in Rome, which testifies to his recognition in the early church.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Community in Rome
keyEvents.description: Phlegon is mentioned together with Asynchrus, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the other brothers, suggesting that they were part of a house church or Christian group in Rome.
